projects.title: Jak Architecture
projects.description:
New website for Jak Architecture, created in collaboration with designer Chloe Larkin. Jak is a local architecture firm whose work strengthens the connection between people, place, and context. 
The site extends JAK’s timeless and culturally responsive ethos, and is built with purpose to endure.

projects.title: AP-REPS
projects.description: Refined and customised a Squarespace build for AP—REPS through bespoke front-end fixes, responsive behaviour and bespoke mobile animations. Collaborated with Lulu Chia to refresh the website for AP-REPS, a leading Australian talent agency.

projects.title: Albus Lumen
projects.description: Custom Shopify Theme updates for Albus Lumen. New Navigation, Category Structure and Blog implementation to improve user experience and site performance.

Brand identity and packaging design for alt. cosmetics, a new beauty brand. The system is built around a tactile, chrome material language: engraved metal artefacts and 3D-led product applications that carry the brand through packaging, point-of-sale and digital surfaces.

projects.title: The Athenaeum
projects.description: UX and UI design for Aesop's Athenaeum, the brand's literary content archive. Restructured an infinite chronological feed into a four-pillar library (Product, Literature & Culture, Wellbeing, Stores & Architecture)

projects.title: Christopher Myles Henderson
projects.description: Portfolio website for Chris Henderson – multidisciplinary artist. Utilising overlays and an asymmetrical grid to accompany the depth and eccentricity of his work
